rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for noon or the middle of the day.

example.english: We go for dim sum at midday.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 ng5 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to twelve o'clock and the daytime context makes clear that you mean noon rather than midnight.

example.english: We start the meeting promptly at midday.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sap6 ji6 dim2 zeon2 si4 hoi1 wui6
